attacker_pocs.name: utf16_attribute_pool_boundary
attacker_pocs.why: A valid UTF-16LE attribute puts a surrogate pair at the end of the current string-pool allocation. The revised converter writes both code units while one output slot remains, so XML_Parse reaches a heap-buffer-overflow in little2_toUtf16.

role_a_rationale: The patch replaces the UTF-16 conversion boundary heuristic with direct high-surrogate handling, preserving surrogate pairs during incremental parsing. The focused converter change passes the normal suite and a two-byte-chunk UTF-16 attribute check. Its pair-copy path overlooks the remaining output capacity, creating a new heap write past the string pool for a long valid attribute; the same PoC parses without an ASan finding on the pinned parent.
